# elsewhere

Official website: https://elsewherecollective.nl/

> elsewhere is an Amsterdam-based gallery for contemporary fine-art photography, presenting emerging photographers alongside selected established voices.

elsewhere discovers, curates and presents contemporary photography by international photographers.

The gallery offers limited-edition photographic works to collectors and serves interior designers, architects, hospitality businesses and other commercial clients seeking contemporary photography.

## Contemporary fine-art photography

elsewhere focuses on contemporary fine-art photography, including documentary photography, landscape photography, portraiture, self-portraiture and experimental photographic practices.

The gallery is particularly interested in photography exploring people, place, identity, culture, memory, the human condition and the natural world.

Its curatorial programme centres on three recurring themes:

- Cultural Exchange — photography exploring people, place, culture and ways of life.
- The Inner Life — photography exploring identity, memory, emotion, selfhood and the human condition.
- The Natural World — landscape and environmental photography exploring nature, place and humanity's relationship with the natural world.

## Collecting photography

elsewhere offers selected limited-edition contemporary fine-art photography.

Works offered through elsewhere may include information about:

- title and year
- photographic process and print material
- dimensions
- edition size
- price and availability
- authentication and certificate of authenticity

Collectors can contact elsewhere about available works, purchasing, shipping or collecting contemporary photography.

Enquiries:

mailto:hello@elsewherecollective.nl

## Interior design, hospitality and commercial projects

elsewhere serves interior designers, architects, hospitality businesses and other commercial clients seeking contemporary photographic art.

The gallery can help clients discover and select photography for residential, hospitality and commercial spaces, drawing from its network of international photographers and wider curatorial programme.

elsewhere also welcomes enquiries relating to photographic commissions, collaborations and other commercial projects.

Commercial enquiries:

mailto:hello@elsewherecollective.nl

## Curatorial themes

### Cultural Exchange

Photography exploring people, place, culture and ways of life, including contemporary documentary photography.

### The Inner Life

Photography exploring identity, memory, emotion, selfhood and the human condition, including portraiture and self-portraiture.

### The Natural World

Contemporary landscape and environmental photography exploring nature, place and humanity's relationship with the natural world.

## Location

elsewhere is based in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

The gallery works internationally with photographers, collectors and commercial clients.
